title: Hitler regime supported Zionist groups and encouraged migration
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Hitler regime supported Zionist groups and encouraged migration, about 1930s-1940s at Europe; British Palestine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Hitler regime did lend support to the uh at that time the sort of Zionist movement to uh take Israel away from the British crown.
